Claim 8 (Currently amended): A composition comprising a lubricant comprising at least one selected from the group consisting of polyol ester and polyvinyl ether and a refrigerant comprising: from 5 to 95% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf); and from 5 to 95% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze), wherein said composition exhibits a Hazen color of about 200 or less as measured by ASHRAE test 97-2007 after a sealed glass tube comprising the composition is welded closed and placed in an oven at 2000 C for 14 days.

Claim 17 (Currently amended): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the refrigerant comprises from 10 to 45% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf) and from 55 to 90% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze).

Claim 18 (Currently amended): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the refrigerant comprises from 20 to 45% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf) and from 55 to 80% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze).

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The composition according to Claim 8, wherein the refrigerant comprises from 20 to 35% by weight of 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (HFO-1234yf) and from 65 to 80% by weight of trans-1,3,3,3-tetrafluoropropene (trans-HFO-1234ze).
